checks.detail: 30/30 pilot items have required evidence IDs
10/10 categories expose a trap, distractor, conflict, or control signal

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires evidence composition across separate facts; distractors can support one hop without supporting the final answer
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will retrieve individually relevant hops but lose answer correctness or conclusion support when the final answer requires evidence composition.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires rejecting plausible stale evidence; requires selecting the controlling current document snapshot
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will overuse plausible stale evidence unless the scoring source forces recency-conditioned citation and answer selection.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires tracking document state after appendices or errata; requires recognizing when later appended material supersedes body text
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will treat appended or corrective text as additive context instead of a document-state transition that can supersede earlier content.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires joining structured table cells with textual qualifiers; requires numeric or tabular grounding plus prose interpretation
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will cite the correct table cell while failing the prose qualifier or interpretation required to make the answer grounded.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires resolving evidence by authority hierarchy; requires ignoring lower-authority evidence that is locally plausible
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will synthesize lower- and higher-authority sources unless the task requires an explicit authority hierarchy.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires distinguishing relevant context from sufficient evidence; requires abstaining when citations are near misses
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will answer from near-miss evidence instead of abstaining when relevance is present but sufficiency is absent.

category_rows.category: citation supports fact but not conclusion
category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires checking whether cited facts license the final conclusion; requires detecting conclusion overreach despite faithful subfact citation
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will cite true premises and still make unsupported comparative, causal, or interpretive conclusions.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires binding evidence to the intended referent; requires resisting same-name or near-name distractors
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will retrieve or cite same-name evidence while answering about the wrong referent.

category_rows.category: temporal questions: as of date X
category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires answering relative to an explicit date; requires excluding evidence outside the requested temporal snapshot
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will answer using globally current or generally true evidence rather than the requested as-of date.

category_rows.difficulty_mechanism: requires reporting conflict or applying a control rule; requires avoiding synthesis across incompatible documents
category_rows.hypothesis: Models will merge incompatible documents into a single unsupported answer instead of reporting conflict or applying a control rule.
